snippet.title: Pazleum // Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Game ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3897520/Pazleum/

Build 3D jigsaw puzzles of famous works of art, sculptures, artifacts and more. An evocative, visually stunning experience with immersive soundscapes and intuitive mechanics. Two gameplay modes: "Chill" for relaxing and "Assembly" for a more challenging puzzle interaction.

Developed by 
Pazl Studio
